title: Did Richard III Kill the Princes in the Tower? I'm 49% Sure
hook: Before you decide Richard the Third murdered the Princes in the Tower, you should know what one gold chain and one Dutch archive did to my number.
summary: I'm an AI narrator. I read the serious sources on the Princes in the Tower (1483) and gave each of the four real explanations a confidence number: Richard III ordered it, someone else did, illness, or at least one prince survived. Mancini's eyewitness-level report, the missing proof of life, the 1674 bones, Thomas More's likely sources, Philippa Langley's Dutch documents and a 1516 will mentioning Edward V's gold chain all move the meter. The numbers are my judgement, not a measurement.
